{{Top|leg}}
'''Farming clusters''' were a division of land used on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Thousands of such clusters were spread across the surface of the planet. The [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]] was typical of Kinyen's farming clusters, with a hexagonal shape subdivided into six triangular plots used to farm [[silvergrass]]. Farming clusters were subject to annual production quotas under Kinyen's [[Socialism|socialist]] [[Tayan League|government]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
